📋 FORMAT

The Gauntlet:
Bishwa ka utkrishta 16 qualified team haru suru mai aamne-saamne hunechhan.

Groups:
Pratyek group bata top 3 team matra sidhai Grand Finals ma pugnechhan.

Last Chance:
Antyama, Last Chance (Dec 5–6) le sabai kura nirnayak mod ma purauneछ.
Dui din. Teen ticket.
Top 3 ma parnuhos, natra Grand Finals bahira batai hernuhos.

🆕 YO SEASON MA NAYA: TDM-Tiebreaker
Gauntlet, Group Stage ra Last Chance ma qualification slot ko lagi point barabar bhayema, barabar bhayeka team haru le aamne-saamne kheleर nirnaya garnechhan:
2 team barabar → uniharu le TDM Tiebreaker khelnechhan
3 wa badhi team barabar → standard niyam anusar antim dui team chhaninechhan, jasle tyaspachhi TDM Tiebreaker khelnechhan
Qualification sanga sambandhit nabhayeka barabari → standard tiebreaker niyam nai lagu hunechha, kunai parivartan chhaina
Tiebreaker match: TDM, Warehouse, 4v4, Best of 3, 5 minute ka round.
Jitne sarta: 15 elimination pahila purauने team le round jitnechha. 5 minute bhitra kunai pani team 15 ma napugema, score ma agadi raheko team le round jitnechha.

Manch tayar chha. Dabab wastabik chha.

Customers can also go behind the scenes of their favorite movies and series with exclusive X-Ray access. Prime Video is one benefit among many that provides savings, convenience, and entertainment as part of the Prime membership. For more info visit www.amazon.com/primevideo.

snippet.title: YUNG DSA - HOOD TALK (OFFICIAL LYRIC VIDEO)
snippet.description:
“Hood Talk”is a commanding street rap anthem that captures YUNG DSA’s rise and growing dominance in 🇮🇳INDIAN hip-hop scene, without losing touch with the streets that shaped him. Blending Pune-rooted slang with the raw essence of hip-hop, the track addresses rivalries, respect, and the realities of making a name in a world where survival and dominance go hand in hand. Anchored by the chant “JAY Shambhu, JAY Shankar,” it reflects the faith and spiritual grounding that have remained constant through his journey, turning a familiar expression of the streets into a statement of strength and conviction. With an unapologetic delivery and unmistakable local identity, “Hood Talk” is YUNG DSA speaking from a place of having made it, while staying firmly connected to where it all began.

Audio Credits:

Artist/Lyrics/Composition: YUNG DSA
Produced by: Starboi Beatz 
Mixing & Mastering: Shubhmix
Studio Recording & Engineer: Shubhmix and Cosmodrop 
 

Video Credits:

Visualiser & Poster: Sushilxcreation
Photographer: Chalta Firta Photographer 

Special Thanks: Homies & To the Real Gs who understands the Sound 

Lyrics:
Jai Shambho Jai Shankar
Na kata na kankar 
Khali hood me chalte RAADE
OPPS log darte ane andar
Ye Trip karte naam pe mere
Jane de bolta maat kar
Me ghusta direct HOOD me 
Ye  rehte ghar ke andar (2x)

Jabhi ghusta HOOD me public bolti WHATSUP MY GANG
Me rep (represent) karta khud ko inke hang hote CLAN
Ye leke baithe past ko mere future ke plans
Mere jaisa thoda fast ho me run karta GANG
Homie bola dikhta watto, YUNG bhau ke gane dhapoo (steal)
Jis din matter hoyega please bolta ghar pe mat bhago
Hyanchi layki kaday mala vel(time) nay me kamat ae vyast(busy)
Rahto Vastit bhau, LA sarkha me shoot la jato 

YUNG RAGIL

Game me pen nahi 
lame nahi 
same nahi 
stain me pain nahi
Vain me game, game me brain nahi 
I’m a THUG from hood, i just now came nahi
mang tu kutla hood reppin? jab tere brain me game nai

Me rep (represent) karta hood ko mera hood me khud bro 
HOODSTAR meko bolte mahnun dolayat tujhya chubto
Ye log dekh ke bhagte jate homie saman lavun 
ghusto 
Teko bas mera Numberkari, bolta hood khud bro

Jai Shambho Jai Shankar
Na kata na kankar 
Khali hood me chalte RAADE
OPPS log darte ane andar
Ye Trip karte naam pe mere
Jane de bolta maat kar
Me ghusta direct HOOD me 
Ye  rehte ghar ke andar (2x)

Zero chh ae map pe aur OG log nap pe
Nadi(river) khod dali 20 saal ke ladke ne RAP seh
Ghar wale bill bharte ghar pe baith ke cash me 
Paise jalta hood(06) me mere shekoti ke ash me 
Chowki shit jab me rep(represent) karta
PUNE city spit karta 

Homie mera lavish jabhi chilum hood ki LIT karta
AIGHTT!!!!!!!
Hum log THUG pahile marte kyu ki lawyer karta defend aur doctor mera thik karta
Ghura ghuri chalu aur me Vision inka thik karta 
Gane mere chilum kabhi FUKTA (smoking ) nahi bro weak ladka???  
STRONG REHRE 💎
Khande (shoulder) heavy pure bachpan seh 
Hood ka me Teacher isliye OP mera fees bharta
Tu jisko HOOD bolta, usko hum log Chowk bolte 
FACHADI ke mudde mere OPS log ke sar (head) kholte
Gangsta jaate tuition mera STREET education 
aur Knowledge itna BILLA meko OPS log pan sir bolte 
COS (cosmo) haynla sang hum log kitne log ke ghar kholte
COS (cosmo) hyanla sang hum log kitne log ke sar(head) kholte 
Me idher bachpan seh baba aur baba log ki sunne padti
Homie tere Maa-Baap pan yech bolte 
Thug bolte YUNG bhau ko saab bolte 
Paisa paani sona chandi saab zhol ke ? 
Muddal (heavy cash) mere rhyme skill ke Shabda tool te 
Beach(sell) kahte OPPS log taak (flex) bolte
LAVISH bolte HOOD me meko SAVAGE bolte
HOMIES mere Sar(head) kholte

Jai Shambho Jai Shankar
Na kata na kankar 
Khali hood me chalte RAADE
OPPS log darte ane andar
Ye Trip karte naam pe mere
Jane de bolta maat kar
Me ghusta direct HOOD me 
Ye  rehte ghar ke andar (2x)

JAI SHAMBHO JAI SHANKAR

.
.
.

snippet.title: Sushant KC - Na Lajai ft. Situsit (Official Music Video)

Presenting Na Lajai, a celebration of love, the beautiful feeling of falling for someone, and our beloved festival, Tihar. A little romance, a little magic, and a story straight from the heart.

Reuniting with Aakriti after Bardali, we’re back to tell another story filled with love, warmth, and beautiful moments.

Made with love, for all of you. ❤️

snippet.title: लक्ष्मी मैया हमारे घर आना | Lakshmi Maiya Hamare Ghar Aana | Diwali Special Laxmi Ganesh Bhajan
snippet.description:
लक्ष्मी मैया हमारे घर आना | Lakshmi Maiya Hamare Ghar Aana | Diwali Special Laxmi Ganesh Bhajan

लक्ष्मी मैया हमारे घर आना | Lakshmi Maiya Hamare Ghar Aana | Riddhi Siddhi Sang Bappa Ko Lana | Diwali Special Laxmi Ganesh Bhajan 2026 | ShivRaga Studio

Lakshmi Maiya Hamare Ghar Aana (Riddhi Siddhi Sang Bappa Ko Lana) – Auspicious & Melodious Diwali Special Laxmi-Ganesh Bhajan 2026, by ShivRaga Studio.

लक्ष्मी मैया हमारे घर आना, रिद्धि सिद्धि संग बप्पा को लाना – सुख समृद्धि का दीप जलाना, माँ कृपा का खजाना लुटाना! शुभ दीपावली 🪔🌸🙏

🙏 भजन के बारे में | ABOUT THIS BHAJAN

दीपावली का पर्व अंधकार पर प्रकाश और घर-आंगन में सुख, समृद्धि व शुभता के आगमन का उत्सव है। "लक्ष्मी मैया हमारे घर आना" एक अत्यंत मधुर और मंगलकारी भजन है, जिसमें भक्त अपने द्वार पर तोरण सजाकर, आंगन में घी के दीपक जलाकर माता लक्ष्मी और विघ्नहर्ता श्री गणेश जी (रिद्धि-सिद्धि सहित) को अपने घर पधारने का भावपूर्ण निमंत्रण देता है।

धनतेरस, रूप चौदस, दीपावली की लक्ष्मी-गणेश पूजा, या प्रतिदिन सुबह-शाम की पूजा में इस पावन भजन को अपने घर व दुकान में चलाएं। माता लक्ष्मी आपके घर अन्न-धन के भंडार भरें! जय माँ लक्ष्मी, जय श्री गणेश 🙏✨

"Lakshmi Maiya Hamare Ghar Aana" by ShivRaga Studio is a joyful, festive Hindi devotional bhajan dedicated to Goddess Lakshmi and Lord Ganesha. With uplifting dholak beats, soothing flute, and the celebratory chorus "Aayi Diwali ki bhor, chhayi khushiyan charon oar", it is the perfect soundtrack for Diwali Puja, Dhanteras, and welcoming prosperity into your home.

bn.description:
লক্ষ্মী মাইয়া এসো আমাদের ঘরে | লক্ষ্মী মাইয়া আমাদের বাড়ি | দিওয়ালি স্পেশাল লক্ষ্মী গণেশ ভজন

লক্ষ্মী মাইয়া এসো আমাদের ঘরে | লক্ষ্মী মাইয়া আমাদের বাড়ি | বাবার সাথে ঋদ্ধি সিদ্ধি | দিওয়ালি স্পেশাল লক্ষ্মী গণেশ ভজন 2026 | শিবরাগ স্টুডিও

লক্ষ্মী মাইয়া হামারে ঘর আনা (রিদ্ধি সিদ্ধি সং বাপ্পা কো লানা) – শিবরাগা স্টুডিও দ্বারা শুভ ও সুমধুর দিওয়ালি স্পেশাল লক্ষ্মী-গণেশ ভজন 2026।

লক্ষ্মী মাইয়া এসো আমাদের ঘরে, ঋদ্ধি সিদ্ধি নিয়ে এসো বাপ্পা – জ্বালিয়ে দাও সুখ-সমৃদ্ধির প্রদীপ, লুট কর মায়ের কৃপা ধন! শুভ দীপাবলি 🪔🌸🙏

🙏 ভজন সম্পর্কে | এই উৎস সম্পর্কে

দীপাবলি উৎসব অন্ধকারের মাঝে আলোর আগমন এবং গৃহে সুখ, সমৃদ্ধি ও সৌভাগ্যের আগমনকে উদযাপন করে। "লক্ষ্মী মাইয়া হামারে ঘর আনা" একটি অত্যন্ত মধুর ও শুভ ভজন, যেখানে ভক্তরা তাঁদের দরজার তোরণ সাজান, উঠোনে ঘিয়ের প্রদীপ জ্বালান এবং মাতা লক্ষ্মীর পূজা করেন, আর বিঘ্নহর্তা আপাজি শ্রী গরিশিতেশ (শ্রী গরিশিতেশ) আবির্ভূত হওয়ার জন্য আন্তরিক আমন্ত্রণ জানান।

ধনতেরাস, রূপ চৌদাস, দীপাবলির লক্ষ্মী-গণেশ পূজা, অথবা প্রতিদিনের সকাল-সন্ধ্যার পূজার সময় আপনার বাড়িতে ও দোকানে এই পবিত্র ভজনটি বাজান। মাতা লক্ষ্মী, আপনার ঘরকে খাদ্য ও সম্পদে পূর্ণ করুন! জয় মা লক্ষ্মী, জয় শ্রী গণেশ 🙏✨

শিবরাগা স্টুডিওর "লক্ষ্মী মাইয়া হামারে ঘর আনা" হল দেবী লক্ষ্মী এবং ভগবান গণেশকে উৎসর্গ করা একটি আনন্দদায়ক, উত্সবপূর্ণ হিন্দি ভক্তিমূলক ভজন। ঢোলকের বাজনা, প্রশান্তিদায়ক বাঁশি, এবং উদযাপনের কোরাস "আয়ি দিওয়ালি কি ভোর, ছাই খুশিয়ান চারন ওড়" সহ, এটি দীপাবলি পূজা, ধনতেরাস এবং আপনার বাড়িতে সমৃদ্ধির জন্য নিখুঁত সাউন্ডট্র্যাক।

snippet.title: Qaafirana - Arijit Singh & Nikita Gandhi | Sushant Singh Rajput & Sara Ali Khan | 8K Video
snippet.description:
❤️ Some journeys become unforgettable when love becomes the destination. 🌄🎶
 Experience the magic of Qaafirana in stunning 8K, featuring Sushant Singh Rajput & Sara Ali Khan. ✨

Song: Qaafirana
Movie: Kedarnath
Singers: Arijit Singh & Nikita Gandhi
Lyrics: Amitabh Bhattacharya
Music: Amit Trivedi
Starring: Sushant Singh Rajput (Remembering), Sara Ali Khan

Qaafirana Lyrics

Lyrics:

In vaadiyon mein
Takra chuke hain
Humse musafir
Yun toh kayi

Dil na lagaya
Humne kisi se
Qisse sune hain
Yun toh kayi

Aise tum mile ho 
Aise tum mile ho
Jaise mil rahi ho
Itr se havaa.. .. 

Qaafirana sa hai
Ishq hai ya kya hai

Aise tum mile ho 
Aise tum mile ho
Jaise mil rahi ho
Itr se havaa.. .. 

Qaafirana sa hai
Ishq hai ya kya hai

Godi mein pahadiyon ki
Ujli dopheri guzaarna
Tere saath mein..
Accha lage.. 

Dhalti huyi sham ne
Bataya hai ke door manzil pe
Raat Hai..

Mujhko tasalli hai yeh
Ke hone talak raat
Hum dono saath hai ..

Sang chal rahe hai
Sang chal rahe hai
Dhoop ke kinare
Chaaon ki tarah

Qaafirana sa hai
Ishq hai ya kya hai

Aise tum mile ho
Aise tum mile ho
Jaise mil rahi ho

Itr se havaa.. .. 

Qaafirana sa hai
Ishq hai ya kya hai

snippet.title: Seti Khola | Preezol Nepali | Official Music Video
snippet.description:
Some songs are too precious to ever be forgotten.

“Seti Khola” is more than just a song; it is a beautiful piece of my grandpa’s legacy. Although he is no longer with us, his music and memories continue to live on.

Most of all, I am grateful to my grandpa for leaving behind such a beautiful song a piece of his heart that we can cherish forever.
A heartfelt thank you to my amazing team for helping turn this special vision into reality.

Technology brought the visuals to life, but the soul of this song will always belong to him.

“Seti Khola” a timeless melody, a precious memory, and a legacy that lives on.

Lyrics and Composition : Ram Saran Nepali
Producer : Preezol nepali

Mere yeh dil se

Teri

se tujhko chura le jaun abhi

snippet.title: CHAND JAISAN CHEHRA | चाँद जइसन चेहरा | UDIT NARAYAN, INDU SONALI | BHOJPURI FILM SONG
snippet.description:
Experience the charm of Bhojpuri film music with “Chand Jaisan Chehra,” featuring the soulful voices of Udit Narayan and Indu Sonali. 🎶❤️ With music composed by Rajesh-Rajnish and lyrics penned by Shyam Dehati, this song brings together memorable vocals and the distinctive flavour of Bhojpuri cinema.

Whether you enjoy classic Bhojpuri film songs or love listening to melodious duets, add this track to your playlist and relive the magic of Bhojpuri music. Share it with fellow music lovers and keep the melodies playing!

Stay connected with T-Series Hamaar Bhojpuri for more entertaining Bhojpuri songs, film music, and musical favourites.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎶❤️ “चाँद जइसन चेहरा” के संगे भोजपुरी सिनेमा के मधुर गीत-संगीत के आनंद लीं!

snippet.title: YOUNG LAMA X VTEN - BIG 24 ( OFFICIAL VIDEO )
snippet.description:
🇳🇵 NEPAL 🇺🇸 USA | TWO COUNTRIES. TWO CITIES. ONE SOUND. 🌍🔥
From the streets of Kathmandu to New York and Boston, two incredibly versatile artists, VTEN & YOUNG LAMA, comes together for their third collaboration, bringing their unique sounds, energy, and creativity across borders.
A collaboration connecting Kathmandu's Nepali hip-hop scene to the Nepali diaspora in the United States.
This music video is a joint visual production between RIOTCOBAIN (NEPAL), SHAN FILMS (Nepal) and NEWCHI PRODUCTIONS (USA), bringing together creative teams working thousands of miles apart with one shared vision.


🎬 MUSIC VIDEO CREDITS
🎤 Performed by: VTEN & YOUNG LAMA
🎧 Mix & Master: @riotcobain l MIXED BY BRADY

Filmed  by: Ghishing21 ( https://www.instagram.com/ghising21/ )
https://www.youtube.com/@UCEi_nTVym-70MoiTVSDR5Pg 

🇺🇸 USA - NEWCHI PRODUCTIONS
    •    Cinematography: Milan Thapa
    •    Production Manager: Mamta Ale
    •    Asst: Rulesh Maharjan
    •    Production: Newchi Productions

🙏 BIG 24s & SPECIAL THANKS

This collaboration is more than just music. It connects artists, filmmakers, and creative communities across continents while representing Nepali hip-hop on a global stage.

📷 Official Facebook: Sijal Tamang
📲 Official Tiktok: @sijal_tamang3

📩Email to contact: zeroxexe045@gmail.com

DISCLAIMER ⚠️

ഈ വീഡിയോ സ്വതന്ത്രമായി സൃഷ്ടിച്ചതാണ്, ഇത് ഒരു ഔദ്യോഗിക ഗരീന പ്രഖ്യാപനം, സ്പോൺസർഷിപ്പ്, പങ്കാളിത്തം അല്ലെങ്കിൽ അംഗീകാരം അല്ല. ഗാരേനയുമായി എനിക്ക് ഔദ്യോഗിക ബന്ധമുണ്ടെന്ന് ഞാൻ അവകാശപ്പെടുന്നില്ല.

🎤 Lyrics: Banjaare - Barsaat

[Intro]
Chhod ke nai chaal padya tu
Tod ke nai chaal padya tu
Ban kaali raat chhaavegi
Tanne meri yaad aavegi

[Chorus]
Ke pyaar isa milna nahi
Kaun mere jisa chaavegi
Chhod ke nai chaal padya tu
Tanne meri yaad aavegi
Ke tanne meri yaad aavegi
Tanne meri yaad aavegi
Chhod ke nai chaal padya tu
Tanne meri yaad aavegi

[Instrumental Break]

[Verse 1]
Ya to manne maar jaanda re
Nyu kyun manne chhod ke gaya
Aansu mere rukte nahi
Isa dil tod ke gaya
Main khul ke nai roya karungi
Jab barsaat aavegi
Chhod ke nai chaal padya tu
Tanne meri yaad aavegi

[Chorus]
Ke pyaar isa milna nahi
Kaun mere jisa chaavegi
Chhod ke nai chaal padya tu
Tanne meri yaad aavegi

[Verse 2]
Sapne sajaaye jaande na, apne bhulaaye jaande na
Ek baar chhod gaye jo, mud ke dubaara aande na
Sapne sajaaye jaande na, apne bhulaaye jaande na
Ek baar chhod gaye jo, mud ke dubaara aande na
Main teri e thi, teri e rahun
Jab tak saans aavegi
Chhod ke nai chaal padya tu
Tanne meri yaad aavegi
Ke tanne meri...

[Outro]
Tu jade rahve raaji rahiye re
Jaan tai bhi pyaara tha re tu
Basde ujaad ke gaya
Kisa banjaara tha re tu


📧 Contact: mgmt.moonshine@gmail.com

hi.title: एलन वॉकर, हमजा मलिक, ज़ैन ज़ोहैब और जेम्स आर्थर - अल्फाज़ (एलन वॉकर रिलाइट)
hi.description:
वो गाना जो हमारी कल्पना से कहीं ज़्यादा बड़ा बन गया। ❤️

snippet.title: तुलसा की आई है बारात मेरे आंगन में | Tulsa Ki Aayi Hai Barat | तुलसी माता भजन | Tulsi Vivah Bhajan
snippet.description:
तुलसा की आई है बारात मेरे आंगन में | Tulsa Ki Aayi Hai Barat | तुलसी माता भजन | Tulsi Vivah Bhajan

Songs : तुलसा की आई है बारात मेरे आंगन में
Music & Composer : Bunty Thakur  
Singer : Kratika Thakur
Lyrics : Bunty Thakur
Editing: Chitrankan Recording Studio
Recording Studio : Chitrankan Recording Studio
Music Label : Bajao Bhakti Music

Presenting this beautiful and peaceful Tulsi Dhun & Radha Rani Dhun to fill your mind with positive energy and devotion to Tulsi Mata.

Experience the ultimate state of devotion with this soulful Tulsi Bhajan, "तुलसा की आई है बारात मेरे आंगन में" (Tulsa Ki Aayi Hai Barat ). This song is a beautiful reminder that Tulsi Mata & Radha Rani is always with us, residing in our every thought and every breath.

🌿 जय तुलसी महारानी! 🦚 जय भगवान शालिग्राम! 🌸 बोलिए श्री बांके बिहारी लाल की जय! 🌿

कार्तिक मास, देवउठनी एकादशी और तुलसी-शालिग्राम विवाह के पावन महापर्व पर Bajao Bhakti आपके लिए लेकर आया है घर-आँगन को शादी के उत्सव और मंगल गीतों की मस्ती से भर देने वाला सबसे सुपरहिट और ऊर्जावान भजन — "तुलसा की आई है बारात मेरे आँगन में (Tulsa Ki Aayi Hai Baarat Mere Aangan Mein)"!

तुलसी माता के विवाह और पावन उत्सव की खुशियों को समर्पित एक सुंदर भक्तिमय भजन — तुलसा की आई है बारात मेरे आँगन में। तुलसी विवाह के इस शुभ अवसर पर सुनिए यह मधुर Tulsi Mata Bhajan और भक्ति के आनंद में रम जाइए।

अगर आप Tulsi Vivah Bhajan, Tulsi Mata Ke Bhajan, Tulsi Ji Ke Bhajan, Ekadashi Bhajan और Hindi Devotional Songs सुनना पसंद करते हैं, तो इस भजन को पूरा सुनें और अपने परिवार व दोस्तों के साथ जरूर शेयर करें।

🌸 "Tulsa Ki Aayi Hai Baarat Mere Aangan Mein" is a vibrant, high-energy Hindi Tulsi Vivah & Radha Krishna Bhajan 2026 by Bajao Bhakti. Celebrating the grand divine wedding of Mother Tulsi (Vrinda Devi) with Lord Shaligram (Shri Krishna), this festive track brings wedding joy, auspiciousness, and prosperity to every home.

snippet.title: Banjaara Mai Tera - Banjaare (Official Video)
snippet.description:
May we all find someone who makes us believe in forever.
Someone to laugh with, dream with, share life’s little moments with and grow old with.
Someone who makes even the simplest days special and all the passing years worthwhile.
Someone to stand by us, grow with us and choose us, again and again, through every season of life.
Because life is simply more beautiful when shared with the right person.
May we all find a love like that.

#BanjaaraMaiTera #banjaare #bairan #barsaat 

Credits
Title: Banjaara Mai Tera
Singer/Lyrics/Composer: BANJAARE
Music: Banjaare, Roni
Mix- Master: Gurie
Animation: The Quirky i

Lyrics:

Aashiq tha bawala,
Banaya tere pyar ne re,
Raata ne jagya mai,
Jagaya tere pyar ne re,
Ranjhe jyu nachya mai,
Nachaya tere pyar ne re.

Mai aashiq tha baawla banaya,
Tere pyaar ne re.

Haan teri ankh se ya,
Motiya ke jode se ye,
Gehre samandar jyu,
Raaj kai lakhore se ye.

Jaadu chalave,
Kyate mane tu fasave,
Chori tane bata,
Mere jise aashiqa k,
Tode se ke.

Fas ke ne baithya mai,
Fasaya tere pyar ne re,
Raata ne jagya mai,
Jagaya tere pyaar ne re,
Raanjhe jyu nachya mai,
Nachaya tere pyaar ne.

Mai aashiq tha baawla,
Banaya tere pyaar ne.

Banjaara, banjaara,
Banjaara mai tera,
Dil haarya, dil haarya,
Dil haarya mai mera.

Zulfa ne khole bairan,
Dophare me saanjh hojya,
Saj ke ne likde th,
Sehar sara jaam hojya.

Aur koi dekhe tane,
Haal mera kaal hojya,
Je tu kare haan chori,
Chora re yo nyaal hojya.

Tere pe haarya mai,
Haraya tere pyar ne re,
Raata ne jagya mai,
Jagaya tere pyaar ne re,
Raanjhe jyu nachya mai,
Nachaya tere pyaar ne.

Mai aashiq tha baawla banaya,
Tere pyaar ne re.

Banjaara, banjaara,
Banjaara mai tera,
Dil haarya, dil haarya,
Dil haarya mai mera.

Kasam te pyaari ghani laage manne,
Ram ki su,
Chori bawaal se, kamaal se tu,
Ram ki suu.

Arsha the aai,
Bemisaal se tu,
Ram ki suu,
Mere gelya chal,
Bahu ban mahre,
Gaam ki tu.

Nasha sa chadya yo,
Chadaya tere pyaar ne re,
Raata ne jaagya mai,
Jagaya tere pyaar ne re,
Raanjhe jyu nachya mai,
Nachaya tere pyaar ne.

Mai aashiq tha baawla,
Banaya tere pyaar ne re.

Aashiq tha baawal,
Banaya tere pyar ne re,
Raata ne jagya mai,
Jagaya tere pyaar ne re,
Raanjhe jyu nachya mai,
Nachya tere pyaar ne.

Mai aashiq tha baawla,
Banaya tere pyaar ne re.

Banjaara, banjaara,
Banjaara mai tera,
Dil harya, dil harya,
Dil harya mai mera.

Chhod ke nai chaal padya tu

Kaun mere jisa chaavegi

Tanne meri yaad aavegi

Ya to manne maar jaanda re
Nyu kyun manne chhod ke gaya
Aansu mere rukte nahi
Isa dil tod ke gaya

Main khul ke nai roya karungi
Jab barsaat aavegi
Chhod ke nai chaal padya tu
Tanne meri yaad aavegi

[Chorus]
Ke pyaar isa milna nahi
Kaun mere jisa chaavegi
Chhod ke nai chaal padya tu
Tanne meri yaad aavegi

Sapne sajaaye jaande na, apne bhulaaye jaande na
Ek baar chhod gaye jo, mud ke dubaara aande na
Sapne sajaaye jaande na, apne bhulaaye jaande na
Ek baar chhod gaye jo, mud ke dubaara aande na

Main teri e thi, teri e rahun
Jab tak saans aavegi
Chhod ke nai chaal padya tu
Tanne meri yaad aavegi
Ke tanne meri...

[Outro]
Tu jade rahve raaji rahiye re
Jaan tai bhi pyaara tha re tu
Basde ujaad ke gaya
Kisa banjaara tha re tu

💻Software - FL studio, Bandlab and SUNO.
____________________________________________

Lyrics:- 

[Intro]

Hmmm… O…
Teri ibaadat…

[Verse 1]

Taaron se chura ke laaya, tere chehre ka ye noor
Teri ek jhalak se jaana, mera dil hai kitna majboor
Hawaon mein ghuli hai jaise, teri meethi si mehak
Teri aankhon mein hai khoi, mere khwaabon ki chamak…
Tu jahan bhi kadam rakhe, khil jaaye naya jahaan
Tere bina ab lage soona, ye zameen aur aasmaan…

[Pre-Chorus]

Tu jo paas aave, meri saans ruk jaave
Dil deewane nu, bas tu hi toh bhaave…

[Chorus]

Asaan teri ibaadat karaan, O sajna
Tere husn di aadat karaan, O sajna
Teri zulfon ke saaye mein, main Rab paa liya
Asaan teri ibaadat karaan, O sajna…
(Ibaadat karaan… O sajna…)

[Verse 2]

Teri payal jo chhanke, toh rukta hai zamaana
Tere husn ka jaadu, tera aashiq hai deewana
Meri raaton ki neendein, tune aankhon se churaayi
Tujhse milkar hi maine, meri duniya hai sajaayi…
Ab tere bina ek pal bhi, mujhko nahi ganwaara
Tu hi meri kashti hai, tu hi mera kinaara…

[Pre-Chorus]

Tu jo paas aave, meri saans ruk jaave
Dil deewane nu, bas tu hi toh bhaave…

[Chorus]

Asaan teri ibaadat karaan, O sajna
Tere husn di aadat karaan, O sajna
Teri zulfon ke saaye mein, main Rab paa liya
Asaan teri ibaadat karaan, O sajna…

[Outro]

Teri ibaadat karaan…
Haan, main Rab paa liya…

snippet.title: Anuv Jain - Arz Kiya Hai (Official Lyrical Video) | Romantic Song
snippet.description:
Some feelings are too beautiful to be put into words and some stories are best told through a song. ❤️

Presenting Arz Kiya Hai by Anuv Jain a heartfelt musical journey that captures the beauty of unspoken emotions, the magic of love and everything that remains unsaid.

With his signature soulful voice and deeply moving melodies, Anuv takes you through a world where every word feels personal, every note touches the heart and every emotion finds its way home.

Because sometimes, all the heart wants to do is make one simple arz… ✨

Listen. Feel. Fall in love.

Lyrics : 

[Instrumental Intro]

[Verse 1]
Kaayar jo the, woh shaayar bane
Ab kya-kya karein yeh ishq mein
Na kehte the kuch jo, lage khoj mein
Kya lafz chune, naye aashiq yeh

[Pre-Chorus]
Ishq mein tere hain Faiz bane
Arz kiya hai
Humne bhi likha kuch tere baare mein hai

[Chorus]
Aise tu lage ki gulaab hai
Aur aise tu lage ki gulaab hai
Baaghon mein dil ke khilke inn fizaaon mein chhaye ho, haaye
Aur waise hum toh tere hi ghulaam hain
Aur waise hum toh tere hi ghulaam hain
Baadshah dil ke, teri baazi mein jo tu chaahe toh

[Verse 2]
Doobе dilo ki kya naav banoon?
Main khud tair paaoon na aankhon mein
Shaayar ki fitrat mein hi doobna
Main kya hi ladoon toofano se

[Pre-Chorus]
Ishq mеin tere hain Faiz bane
Arz kiya hai
Humne bhi likha kuch tere baare mein hai

[Chorus]
Haathon ko sambhale mere haathon mein
Kaise haathon ko sambhale mere haathon mein
Jab tak neend na aaye, inn lakeeron mein baatein ho, haaye

[Sargam]
Sa-re-pa-ga-re-sa, re-ga-pa-ga, pa-ni, pa-ni
Sa-re-pa-ni, pa-ga, pa-ma, ga-ma, ga-re, ga-re, sa-ni-sa
Sa-re-sa-ni-pa-ni, sa-ga-re, re-ga-pa-ni-sa-ga
Ga-re-sa-re-sa-ni, ma-dha-pa
Pa-ni-sa-ni-pa-ni, pa-ga-pa-re-re-sa
Re-ga, re-ga, ma-dha, pa-ni, pa-ni, sa-ni-dha
Sa-ni, sa-ni, pa-dha, pa-ma, ga-ma-ga

[Bridge]
Haan, sab ne toh sab keh diya hai
Kya hi kahoon jo abhi bhi ankaha hai
Main, haaye, na Mirza, na Mir
Na maahir, na zaahir karoon kuch naya main
Haaye, par jo bhi likha hai, jiya hai
Haan, jiya hai
Aise, aise, aise kaise? Waise jaise

[Chorus]
Jaise main padhoon mere dil mein jo
Meri aankhein bhi padhe teri aankhon ko
Kya yeh mehfil mein baithein ya uthein daud jaane ko? Haaye
Teri aankhon mein taareefon ki talaash hai
Meri mehfil tere jaane se veeraan hai
Main bas shaayar bana hoon sirf tu sun'ne aaye toh

[Outro]
Shaayad shaayar bana hoon
Sirf tu sun'ne aaye toh

कायर जो थे, वो शायर बने
अब क्या-क्या करें ये इश्क़ में
ना कहते थे कुछ जो, लगे खोज में
क्या लफ़्ज़ चुने, नए आशिक़ ये

इश्क़ में तेरे हैं फ़ैज़ बने
अर्ज़ किया है
हमने भी लिखा कुछ तेरे बारे में है

ऐसे तू लगे कि ग़ुलाब है
और ऐसे तू लगे कि ग़ुलाब है
बागों में दिल के खिलके इन फ़िज़ाओं में छाए हो, हाय
और वैसे हम तो तेरे ही ग़ुलाम हैं
और वैसे हम तो तेरे ही ग़ुलाम हैं
बादशाह दिल के तेरी बाज़ी में जो तू चाहे तो

डूबे दिलों की क्या नाव बनूँ?
मैं ख़ुद तैर पाऊँ ना आँखों में
शायर की फ़ितरत में ही डूबना
मैं क्या ही लड़ूँ तूफ़ानों से

इश्क़ में तेरे हैं फ़ैज़ बने
अर्ज़ किया है
हमने भी लिखा कुछ तेरे बारे में है

हाथों को संभालें मेरे हाथों में
कैसे हाथों को संभालें मेरे हाथों में
जब तक नींद ना आए, इन लकीरों में बातें हो, हाय

हाँ, सब ने तो सब कह दिया है
क्या ही कहूँ जो अभी भी अनकहा है
मैं, हाय, ना मिर्ज़ा, ना मीर, ना माहिर, ना ज़ाहिर
करूँ कुछ नया मैं
हाय, पर जो भी लिखा है, जिया है
हाँ, जिया है
ऐसे, ऐसे, ऐसे, कैसे, वैसे, जैसे

जैसे मैं पढ़ूँ मेरे दिल में जो
मेरी आँखें भी पढ़ें तेरी आँखों को
क्या यह महफ़िल में बैठें या उठें
दौड़ जाने को? हाय
तेरी आँखों में तारीफ़ों की तलाश है
मेरी महफ़िल तेरे जाने से वीरान है
मैं बस शायर बना हूँ
सिर्फ़ तू सुनने आए तो
शायद शायर बना हूँ सिर्फ़ तू सुनने आए तो

en-US.title: Anuv Jain - Arz Kiya Hai (Official Lyrical Video) | Romantic Song
en-US.description:
Some feelings are too beautiful to be put into words and some stories are best told through a song. ❤️

Presenting Arz Kiya Hai by Anuv Jain a heartfelt musical journey that captures the beauty of unspoken emotions, the magic of love and everything that remains unsaid.

With his signature soulful voice and deeply moving melodies, Anuv takes you through a world where every word feels personal, every note touches the heart and every emotion finds its way home.

Because sometimes, all the heart wants to do is make one simple request…

Listen. Feel. Fall in love.

Lyrics:

[Instrumental Intro]

[Verse 1]
The singers became poets.
Now what should I do in this love?
Those who didn't say anything are searching.
What words should I choose, these new lovers.

[Pre-Chorus]
In love, you have become Faiz.
I have requested that I too have written something about you.

[Chorus]
You felt like a rose,
And you felt like a rose,
The flowers of the heart are blooming in the gardens, oh my God.
And in fact, I am your slave.
And in fact, I am your slave. Yes, King of hearts, I can do whatever you want in your game.

[Verse 2]
What boat should I build for the broken hearts? I myself am not thirsty, nor am I drowned in the rain in my eyes.
It is the poet's nature to drown myself in the storms.

[Pre-Chorus]
In love with you, I have become a blessing.

I have submitted that I have also written something about you.

[Chorus]
Hold the hands in my hands.
How do you hold the hands in my hands?
Until sleep comes, let's talk in these lakes, oh my god.

[Sargam]
Sa-re-pa-ga-re-sa, re-ga-pa-ga, pa-ni, pa-ni
Sa-re-pa-ni, pa-ga, pa-ma, ga-ma, ga-re, ga-re, Sa-ni-sa
Sa-re-sa-ni-pa-ni, sa-ga-re, re-ga-pa-ni-sa-ga
Ga-re-sa-re-sa-ni, ma-dha-pa
Pa-ni-sa-ni-pa-ni, pa-ga-pa-re-re-sa
Re-ga, re-ga, ma-dha, pa-ni, pa-ni, sa-ni-dha
Sa-ni, sa-ni, pa-dha, pa-ma, ga-ma-ga

[Bridge]
Yes, everyone has said it all.
What should I say about what is still unsaid?
I, yes, am not Mirza, nor Mir.
I am not Mahir, nor should I reveal anything new.
Yes, but whatever I have written, I have lived it.
Yes, I have lived it.
Like this, like this How? Just like

[Chorus]
Like I read what is in my heart
So that my eyes also read your eyes
Did he sit in the gathering or did he get up to run? Hey!
Your eyes are searching for praise.
My gathering is saddened by your departure.
I have become a poet, just because you came to hear me.

[Outro]
Maybe I have become a poet, just because you came to hear me.

In your love, I have become Faiz.
I have said,
I have also written something about you.

You bloom in the gardens of my heart and fill the air.
Alas, I am your slave.
And I am your slave.
Your king of my heart. If you want, in a game,

Should I become a boat for drowning hearts?

If I can't swim in your eyes myself,

It's in a poet's nature to drown.

Why should I fight the storms?

In your love, I have become Faiz.

I have said something about you too.

Let my hands be held in my hands.

How can I hold my hands in my hands?

Until sleep comes, let these lines speak, alas.

What can I say about what is still unsaid?
I, alas, am neither Mirza, nor Mir, nor Mahir, nor shall I reveal anything new.
Alas, but whatever I have written, I have lived it.
Yes, I have lived it.
This way, this way, this way, how, that way, as I may.

Whatever I read in my heart,
My eyes too read your eyes.
Should I sit in this gathering or should I get up
to run? Alas,
Your eyes are searching for praise.
My gathering is desolate with your departure.
I have become a poet only if you come to listen.

snippet.description:
🙏 ॐ जय लक्ष्मी माता 🙏🪔🌺 शुभ दीपावली! जय माँ लक्ष्मी! 🌺🪔
दीपावली के पावन पर्व पर माँ लक्ष्मी और भगवान श्री गणेश की विधि-विधान से पूजा करने के पश्चात परिवार सहित श्रद्धा और भक्ति के साथ गाएँ माँ लक्ष्मी की मंगल आरती – ॐ जय लक्ष्मी माता🙏🙏प्रस्तुत है T-Series Bhakti Sagar की ओर से माँ लक्ष्मी की यह पावन आरती।
अनुराधा पौडवाल जी के मधुर स्वरों माँ लक्ष्मी की यह पावन आरती आपके दीपावली पूजन को भक्तिमय बनाएगी। आइए, आरती की पवित्र ज्योत के साथ माँ लक्ष्मी का स्वागत करें और उनसे अपने परिवार की सुख-समृद्धि, शांति, खुशहाली और मंगल की कामना करें।में माँ लक्ष्मी की यह पावन आरती आपके दीपावली पूजन को भक्तिमय बनाएगी। आइए, आरती की पवित्र ज्योत के साथ माँ लक्ष्मी का स्वागत करें और उनसे अपने परिवार की सुख-समृद्धि, शांति, खुशहाली और मंगल की कामना करें।

माँ लक्ष्मी की कृपा से आप सभी के जीवन में धन-धान्य, सुख, शांति और समृद्धि बनी रहे।

आप सभी को दीपावली की हार्दिक शुभकामनाएँ!

माँ लक्ष्मी धन, वैभव, सुख, समृद्धि और सौभाग्य की देवी हैं। श्रद्धा और भक्ति के साथ माँ लक्ष्मी की आरती का पाठ एवं श्रवण करें और उनका दिव्य आशीर्वाद प्राप्त करें।

bn.title: 😱GTA 5-এ শেরু ভাইয়ের রহস্যময় কন্টেইনার
bn.description:
দাবিত্যাগ

এই ভিডিওটি গ্র্যান্ড থেফট অটো ভি (GTA V) ভিডিও গেমের মধ্যে সম্পূর্ণভাবে তৈরি একটি সিনেম্যাটিক গেমপ্লে স্টোরি।

এখানে দেখানো সমস্ত চরিত্র, যুদ্ধ, যানবাহন, ইফেক্ট এবং ঘটনা কাল্পনিক এবং একটি সিমুলেটেড ভার্চুয়াল গেম পরিবেশে ঘটে। যেকোনো অ্যাকশন সিকোয়েন্স, যুদ্ধের দৃশ্য বা ধ্বংসযজ্ঞ গেমের মেকানিক্সের অংশ এবং বাস্তব নয়।

এই কন্টেন্টটি কঠোরভাবে বিনোদন এবং গল্প বলার উদ্দেশ্যে তৈরি করা হয়েছে এবং এটি বাস্তব জগতের সহিংসতা, ক্ষতিকর আচরণ বা বিপজ্জনক কার্যকলাপকে উৎসাহিত করে না।

কিছু চরিত্র জনপ্রিয় কাল্পনিক জগৎ থেকে অনুপ্রাণিত হতে পারে। তাদের নিজ নিজ চরিত্র এবং মেধাস্বত্বের সমস্ত অধিকার তাদের মূল নির্মাতাদের। এই ভিডিওটি একটি ফ্যান-মেড, রূপান্তরমূলক গেমপ্লে প্রজেক্ট এবং এটি কোনো স্বত্বাধিকারীর সাথে অনুমোদিত বা তাদের দ্বারা সমর্থিত নয়।

গেমপ্লের ভিজ্যুয়াল এবং গল্প বলার মান উন্নত করতে মোড এবং কাস্টম অ্যাসেট ব্যবহার করা হয়েছে। সমস্ত দৃশ্য গেমের পরিবেশের মধ্যেই রেকর্ড করা হয়েছে।

snippet.title: Mahiya (Official Music Video) Badshah x Shreya Ghoshal - Mahiya ft. Avneet Kaur
snippet.description:
Something very special to my heart is yours now! The collaboration I’ve been waiting for for so long is finally here. Mahiya has always been so close to my heart, and now it’s yours too.
It’s all Shreya Ma’am, Avneet and now YOU!

Give it all the love you can. ❤️

#Mahiya #shreyaghoshal #badshah #avneetkaur #romanticsong 

Audio Credits :- 
➟ Singer : Badshah, Shreya Ghoshal 
➟ Lyrics : Badshah
➟ Composed : Badshah 
➟ Music Produced : Hiten
➟ Mixed & Mastered : Hanish Taneja
➟ Sarangi : Momin Khan
➟ Guitars- Rhythm Shaw

Lyrics :- 
Mahiya Yeh jhumke bindiya chura ke nindiya le jayenge teri,
O piya, tujhe hi dil diya haan kaun iss tarah ho jayegi teri?

Teri aankhein bataye ke tu soyi nahi hai,
Sukoon humko bhi nahi hai,
Mujhe dekh ke shayad lage naa tujhe,
Par aashiq mere jaisa koi nahi hai.
Wajib bechainiyan hai teri,
Mujh mein bhi khaamiyan batheri,
Chahe jahan bhi jau dikhe,
Mujh pe nishaaniyan hai teri.
Joh tu na dikhe toh ye aankhein kis kaam ki?
Zikr na tera toh ye baatein kis kaam ki?
Fikr na kisi bhi baat ki,
Kar tu khaamakha,
Bina raani ke badshah kis kaam ka?

Mahiya Yeh jhumke bindiya chura ke nindiya le jayenge teri,
O piya, tujhe hi dil diya haan kaun iss tarah ho jayegi teri?

Sukoon denge, Sanak denge, Zameen denge, Falak denge
Joh maangega tu haske jaan, tere hanthon me rakh denge.
Bekhabar, rakh thodi si khabar, Kari na jo qadar, hojayegi deri.

Teri parchaayi main banu,
Tanhai main jarun,
Teri aahein main bharu.
Maine maanga tujhe, lagi aake mujhe,
Kisi dua ke jaise tu,
Teri parchaayi main banu,
Tanhai main jarun,
Teri aahein main bharu.
Maine maanga tujhe, lagi aake mujhe,
Kisi dua ke jaise tu,

Rahe na kisi bhi kaam ke,
Jab se bane hain deewane tere naam ke,
Its your boy
jo meri bani hai jaan,
Aave le na chahti jaan meri jaan ke,
Ho jaaye tere...

snippet.title: Lakshmi Narayan Stotram by Devrishi
snippet.description:
Lakshmi Narayan Stotram | श्री लक्ष्मी नारायण स्तोत्रम् | By Devrishi

🙏 श्री लक्ष्मी नारायण स्तोत्रम् — भगवान श्रीहरि विष्णु एवं माता महालक्ष्मी की दिव्य स्तुति।

प्रस्तुत है देवऋषि की भक्तिमय संगीत रचना लक्ष्मी नारायण स्तोत्रम् , जो सृष्टि के पालनकर्ता भगवान श्रीमन्नारायण और ऐश्वर्य, सौभाग्य एवं समृद्धि की अधिष्ठात्री देवी महालक्ष्मी को समर्पित है।

सनातन परंपरा में भगवान विष्णु धर्म, संरक्षण एवं संतुलन के प्रतीक हैं, जबकि माता लक्ष्मी श्री, सौभाग्य और मंगल की अधिष्ठात्री हैं। श्री लक्ष्मी नारायण की संयुक्त आराधना को गृहस्थ जीवन में सुख, शांति, सौहार्द और समृद्धि का प्रतीक माना गया है।

Experience the divine devotion of Shri Lakshmi Narayan Stotram by Devrishi, a sacred musical offering dedicated to Lord Vishnu (Narayana) and Goddess Mahalakshmi.

Immerse yourself in the devotional vibrations of Vishnu Lakshmi Stotram, celebrating divine harmony, peace, prosperity and spiritual blessings.

🪷 श्री लक्ष्मी नारायणाय नमः।

Music: Devrishi
